cohort: 161 newborns with perinatal asphyxia at Enugu State University Teaching Hospital, Enugu, Nigeria
finding: Predictors of neonatal mortality from perinatal asphyxia included being female, being born outside the hospital, and low oxygen saturation, heart rate, and respiratory rate at presentation.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery significantly differentiated the degrees of asphyxia in newborns based on Sarnat stage.
